acquisition_method.authentication: Authorization: Bearer, key read from the environment only
acquisition_method.geometry_decoding: read-only GET {workspace}/{project}/images/{id}; polygon boxes from 'points', mask boxes from base64(zlib(COCO compressed RLE counts)) in 'mask', decoded against the full original canvas in [height, width] order
acquisition_method.verification: every recovered instance re-measured with pycocotools; measured area and derived bbox checked against the provider's declared area and box

canonical_snapshot.version_4_relationship: version 4 is an older annotation snapshot of the same 436 source images; it is retained as the acquisition record and as the drift reference, not as the canonical annotation source

drift_summary.compared_against: version-4 non-augmented representation of each source image

excluded_provider_category.name: object
excluded_provider_category.reason: placeholder category declared by the export with zero annotations

limitations: Two live-source records (image OQJwjQoYsf1KUgr9G0V8, annotations I and J) carry a class and a bounding box but no segmentation geometry. Visual review shows both fall on a real distant worker, so they are valid objects with unsupported geometry. They are counted in the 2031 total and must be handled explicitly by phase 5B, not silently dropped.

All 76 annotations added since version 4 lie at least 80% inside an annotation of their own class that the snapshot already had, and are under half its area (median 0.44%). RESOLVED IN PHASE 5B: this was originally read as evidence that they add no coverage and are fragments, and that reading was withdrawn. They are a mixture of degenerate slivers and legitimate corrections - instance splits, coarse annotations replaced by several precise ones, and geometry refinements - which no geometric rule separates. Automatic filtering was rejected (fragment_rule_status = REJECTED_FOR_AUTOMATIC_FILTERING) and all 2031 annotations are retained.

The canonical state is the provider's live project, which can change again. Its reproducibility rests on the recorded recovery method plus the committed artifact hashes, not on the provider freezing anything.

The provider's stored bounding boxes agree with the recovered geometry to 0.0 px in the live state, but phase 4B measured them disagreeing by up to 123.5 px inside the version-4 export. Detection boxes must still be derived from segmentation, as the constitution requires.
Annotation correctness itself was not assessed against any independent ground truth. No such reference exists for this dataset.
